item.title: Cops Nab Machine Gun-Armed Teens at Takeout Restaurant
item.description: Chicago Police announced the arrests of Jon Twist, 18, and Santino Rico, 19, in connection with multiple gun charges after citizens noticed a dropped gun and called 911. Chicago Police arrest Jon Twist, 18, and Santino Rico, 19, on Monday, February 23. Dropped gun has callers alerting 911. Cops arrived so fast, suspects were still browsing the menu, owner says.

item.title: Middle School Gets STEAM-y for Chinese New Year
item.description: Evergreen Academy Middle School celebrated the Year of the Horse with a daylong STEAM fair combining science, math and arts learning with Chinese culture. Evergreen Academy Middle School celebrates the Year of the Horse. Daylong Spring Festival STEAM fair combines learning with Chinese culture. Students drum, dance, solve math puzzles and more at hands-on stations.

item.title: City's Geographic Center Again Hosts Chicago's Birthday Party
item.description: The McKinley Park neighborhood celebrated Chicago for the third year in a row with music, ceremony, cake, Chicago-style hot dogs and singing Happy Birthday to Chicago in multiple languages. The McKinley Park neighborhood celebrates the City of Chicago for the third year in a row. Collaborative community party includes performances, ceremony and Chicago-style hot dogs. Event looks to continue at 37th and Honore with next celebration scheduled for March 4, 2027.

item.title: Fabulous Neighbors Have Fun at the Chicago's Birthday Party Photo Booth
item.description: Chicago's Birthday Party on March 4, 2026, at the geographic center of Chicago included many free amenities for attendees, including a photo booth provided courtesy of RIO Event Studios. Enjoy these photos of neighbors having a good time getting their picture taken at the big celebration.
